# chemicalresistance.org

## About
ChemicalResistance.org is a free chemical resistance reference tool. It provides compatibility data for 1,600+ chemicals against 24 materials including HDPE, PTFE, Viton, Stainless Steel, and more.

## Features
- Chemical resistance chart with 1,600+ chemicals and 24 materials
- SDS (Safety Data Sheet) decoder tool
- Chemical storage compatibility guide
- Available in English, Spanish, German, French, and Portuguese

## Content
- ~1,600 individual chemical pages with full material compatibility data
- 24 material-specific pages showing all chemical resistances
- Chemical storage compatibility recommendations
- SDS decoder for safety data sheet interpretation

## URLs
- Homepage: https://chemicalresistance.org/
- Chemicals index: https://chemicalresistance.org/chemicals/
- SDS Decoder: https://chemicalresistance.org/sds-decoder/
- Storage Guide: https://chemicalresistance.org/storage-compatibility/
- About: https://chemicalresistance.org/about/
